name: Kaveri

sink.name: Kaveri Delta
sink.location: Bay of Bengal, near Poompuhar, Mayiladuthurai district, Tamil Nadu

did_you_know: Called the 'Ganga of the South', the Kaveri is considered so sacred that a sip of its water is traditionally regarded as equal to bathing in the Ganga.
Its waters have been at the centre of one of India's longest-running interstate river disputes, between Karnataka and Tamil Nadu, dating back to agreements from 1892 and 1924.
The delta town of Poompuhar (ancient Kaveripoompattinam) near its mouth was one of the busiest ports of the ancient world, trading with Rome and Southeast Asia.
